captions.detailed: A corner-mount CCTV camera assembly featuring a gray, angled steel mounting plate that fits a 90-degree corner. A black horizontal cylindrical arm extends from the plate to support a black mounting yoke, which holds a white dome-style camera housing with a clear, semi-spherical lower lens. The assembly features two degrees of freedom: a vertical revolute joint allowing the camera yoke to pan, and a horizontal revolute joint allowing the camera head to tilt.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a corner-mounted CCTV security camera. It should feature a gray 90-degree corner bracket, a black horizontal support arm, a black panning yoke with a vertical rotation axis, and a white dome camera housing that tilts on a horizontal axis.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate using a right-angled extrusion combined with a flat face plate and cylindrical support collar. Model the support arm as a horizontal cylinder extending to a vertical pivot collar. Build the yoke assembly using a combination of boxes and cylinders to form the U-shaped bracket, and model the camera dome by unioning a truncated cylinder with a sphere for the lens portion. Connect these components using two revolute joint definitions with defined rotational axes.
